name: UCI Yeast Database
description: The UCI Yeast dataset is a bioinformatics benchmark for multiclass cellular localization site prediction of yeast proteins. Derived from SWISS-PROT sequences by Kenta Nakai and Minoru Kanehisa, it contains 1,484 protein instances described by eight continuous predictive features derived from sequence analysis and classified into 10 subcellular localization sites.
